newsitem.title: BELGIUM: German funds extend Belgian property investments.
newsitem.headline: German funds extend Belgian property investments.

text.p: Banimmo, a subsidiary of Belgian bank AnHyp, has sold three central Brussels properties to German real estate fund Despa, international property agents Jones Lang Wootton said in a statement.
The transaction was worth between 1.8 and 1.9 billion francs, JLW said. It was Despa's second purchase on the Brussels market.

JLW said separately that German property fund Westinvest 1 had acquired a 7,338 square metre building on the outskirts of Brussels for around 900 million francs. It was Westinvest's fourth investment on the Belgian market.
The property, acquired from Belgian property company Bernheim Outremer, had been let to Belgian construction firm Besix on a nine-year lease starting January 1, 1999.
The building will be Besix's new headquarters, JLW said.
